tips_en: Start with the on-policy distillation paper (Paper 3): its counterintuitive 'data-overfed but algorithm-starved' hypothesis, supported by clean one-shot experiments and broad cross-domain gains, reframes how we think about data efficiency in LLM training. Then read the multi-agent reflection paper (Paper 2), which complements this by theoretically explaining why and when learning dynamics plateau—offering a unifying lens on training efficiency that links back to Paper 3's findings. The robotics paper (Paper 1) can be saved for last as a self-contained contribution on dexterous manipulation, with no direct conceptual overlap.
tips_zh: 建议先读第三篇关于策略内蒸馏（OPD）的论文：其反直觉的“数据过剩而算法饥饿”假说，配合简洁的单样本实验和跨领域的广泛增益，重新审视了LLM训练中的数据效率问题。之后可读第二篇多智能体反思论文，该文从理论上解释了学习动力学会在何时停滞，与第三篇在训练效率主题上形成呼应。第一篇机器人操作论文可留到最后单独阅读，其在灵巧操作方面的贡献相对独立，与前两篇没有直接的概念交叉。
